name: Mandasuchus
sum: Mandasuchus is a quadrupedal, long-necked carnivorous loricatan from the Middle Triassic Manda Formation of Tanzania.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; formally described by Butler et al. in 2018.
material: Several specimens from the Manda Beds, including referred material.
biology: A quadrupedal carnivore with a relatively long neck.
author: Charig 1967

images.artist: The Trustees of the Natural History Museum, London
images.caption: Referred material of Mandasuchus.
